title: Weather
description: The rain state's numbers, per docs/adr/0015-rain-as-sim-state.md and docs/16-weather.md's content shape: a weather state is one JSON entry with its duration ranges and what it moves. One entry ships (weather.rain). NOTE: the content validator is shallow -- it checks these top-level types and rejects unexpected top-level keys, and does not recurse into the two range objects; check_m2_weather.gd's CONTENT lane holds the inner shape (min < max, the three drying timings in order, the scent multiplier inside (0, 1)).

id.description: Stable namespaced id. Permanent once shipped.

dryTicks.description: Ticks between two spells of rain, drawn uniformly in [min, max] on the `weather` stream. 12000 ticks to the in-game hour.

wetTicks.description: Ticks one spell of rain lasts, drawn the same way.

scentHalfLifeMul.description: What rain multiplies the scent half-life by (calibration.attention's scentHalfLifeMinutes) -- docs/16's 'masks scent heavily', the good half of rain. 0.5 halves it. Expressed as a half-life factor and not a per-step one on purpose: the diffusion step runs every five ticks, so a per-step factor of 0.85 compounded 240 times a minute and flattened the whole field inside a second of rain, which the balance harness read as a colony wipe (docs/23's Weather record). SimAttentionField.diffuse_scent derives the per-step decay from its own constant; SimBoot._diffuse hands this in.

wetAfterTicks.description: How long a body stands in the rain before it counts as wet. Ten seconds at 20 Hz for the shipped 200.

dryAfterTicks.description: How long a wet body stays wet once out of the rain with no fire -- the bad half of rain: a wet survivor reads one temperature band colder for this long. An hour for the shipped 12000.

dryByFireTicks.description: How long a wet body takes to dry standing within a lit campfire's heat. Twelve minutes for the shipped 2400; must be below dryAfterTicks or the fire is no help.
